awardBodies.name: CAMRA (Campaign for Real Ale) - London branch Pub of the Year
awardBodies.note: RESOLVED (Claude's call, confirmed by Rob 13 Sep 2026): CAMRA's real structure IS per-branch - there is no single London-wide winner, so recording it per-branch is the faithful representation, not a workaround (see 'never invent a scheme', trap 1). Collect the CURRENT YEAR's overall branch Pub of the Year for each of the 13 Greater London branches (Bexley, Bromley, Croydon & Sutton, East London & City, Enfield & Barnet, Kingston & Leatherhead, North London, Richmond & Hounslow, South East London, South West Essex, South West London, West London, West Middlesex - full list and branch sites at london.camra.org.uk/viewnode.php?id=1249). Record the BRANCH-LEVEL winner only, not sub-district rounds within a branch (some branches, e.g. SE London, run district heats first - the branch winner is the meaningful unit here, matching how this topic treats every other judged award). If a branch's current-year winner isn't published or findable, note it as a gap rather than drilling further - proportionality matters more than completeness on one award body among five. 'Champion Beer of London' (viewnode.php?id=200569) judges BEERS BREWED in London, not pub venues - confirmed by reading it, and is NOT a usable venue source for this topic.
